purpose.summary: This program generates a bank remittance file ('arquivo remessa') for Banco do Brasil, a Brazilian bank. It reads accounts receivable and customer data from indexed files, builds structured remittance records (header, detail, trailer), and writes them to a sequential output file. It also produces a printed report of the remittance.
